Name: Days Gone
Author: Pawana93
Description:
Have you ever tried some kind of "100 days of Stardew Valley" Content? Then you know, that keeping count of the days is not so easy and a bit of editing afterwards.

Now you can save some time!

Days Gone is a mod, that adds a little counter on your screen, showing on which day you are right now.

Perfect to save you time while editing or making Content or Challenges that depends on which day you are on

Downloads.Description: The first Version of the DaysGone Counter
